selection_rule: Resolve one morphology only for SPECULATIVE_OBJECT, after the hypothetical function and object family are known. Begin from a retro-future geometric archetype, then integrate the function into that volume. Never begin from a present-day product and merely round its corners.

global_contract.form_ancestry: Streamline Moderne, postwar coachbuilding, mid-century space-age illustration, bubble canopies, molded fiberglass, and optimistic world-fair futurism—not contemporary EV, smartphone, appliance, or cold minimal-product language.
construction_order: choose one dominant geometric body: sphere, ovoid, teardrop, inflated spindle, or softly rising monolith
exaggerate one proportion so the silhouette is memorable before small details appear
integrate one transparent canopy, aperture, or observation opening into the dominant volume
add only 1–3 function-bearing seams, supports, fins, docking bands, wheel shrouds, or sensor openings that follow the same curvature
required_character: continuous convex curves and generous radii dominate the outer silhouette
the object feels rounded, buoyant, aerodynamic, and slightly theatrical rather than optimized by current industrial-design convention
glazing is volumetric bubble glass or a rounded portal, never a flat black screen slab
materials feel warm and tactile: colored enamel, molded fiberglass, creamy lacquer, translucent resin, warm chrome trim, amber or smoke-tinted glass, and optional upholstered interior
rendering may be sculptural, illustrated, model-like, or softly surreal; realism is subordinate to silhouette clarity, warmth, and imaginative exaggeration
one or two seams may explain opening, docking, suspension, or maintenance; decorative control noise is absent
hard_failures: a current car, appliance, laptop, speaker, robot, or phone with rounded corners
faceted stealth surfaces, razor edges, angular cybertruck geometry, or aggressive contemporary supercar stance
black panoramic glass bands, full-width LED strips, touchscreen-first dashboards, RGB light, holographic UI, or cold gray-white minimalism
generic matte ceramic blob with no silhouette exaggeration, canopy, aperture, or functional construction logic
photoreal automotive advertising, cinematic road scenes, chrome covering the whole object, or hard neon rim light

morphologies.name: Bubble capsule
morphologies.idea: An inhabited or instrumented sphere/ovoid whose transparent dome is a major part of the silhouette.
morphologies.silhouette: one near-spherical or egg-shaped body with a large convex glass canopy or rounded portal occupying roughly one-third to two-thirds of the visible front or upper volume
morphologies.exaggeration: make the canopy unusually generous and the lower shell compact, swollen, or suspended
morphologies.aperture_rule: use one continuous bubble canopy or deep rounded portal with a warm trim ring; no flat windshield or black glass band
construction_cues: one opening or docking seam following the sphere
one integrated cradle, keel, or suspension point
optional upholstered inner shell visible through the canopy
morphologies.material_direction: colored fiberglass or creamy lacquer body, clear or softly tinted bubble glass, restrained warm chrome or brushed metal ring, tactile upholstered interior when inhabited

morphologies.name: Streamline pod
morphologies.idea: A motion object designed from a water droplet, seed, or airfoil rather than from an existing vehicle category.
morphologies.silhouette: one swelling rounded nose flowing into an elongated teardrop, torpedo, or tadpole tail with uninterrupted aerodynamic curvature
morphologies.exaggeration: stretch the body length, taper the tail, and reduce wheels, supports, or propulsion parts to subordinate integrated forms
morphologies.aperture_rule: embed one bubble canopy, low rounded cockpit opening, or convex observation band into the main volume
construction_cues: shrouded wheel, hover keel, or integrated runner
one tail fin, vent, or lamp grown from the body curvature
morphologies.material_direction: optimistic colored enamel or molded composite, soft glass canopy, small warm-metal edge details, cream or caramel cabin accents

morphologies.name: Biomorphic apparatus
morphologies.idea: A functional device that feels grown, inflated, or softly molded while retaining one readable purpose.
morphologies.silhouette: one asymmetrical inflated body, joined lobes, or soft shell whose convex surfaces flow continuously around a contained core
morphologies.exaggeration: enlarge one lobe, aperture, handle loop, or contained core until it becomes the memorable silhouette event
morphologies.aperture_rule: use one rounded lens, translucent core, recessed mouth, or convex window integrated into the soft body
construction_cues: one integrated grip, cradle, or mount
one aperture or contained core that visibly supports the function
morphologies.material_direction: colored resin, lacquered composite, translucent membrane, soft metal edge, or tactile rubberized detail; never anonymous all-white ceramic

morphologies.name: Soft vertical infrastructure
morphologies.idea: Architecture or transit equipment expressed as elongated rounded fins, arches, and pod-like thresholds rather than glass-box modernism.
morphologies.silhouette: one or more tall softly tapered monoliths, rounded fins, inflated arches, or pod thresholds sharing the same continuous radius language
morphologies.exaggeration: make vertical elements unusually slender and rounded, or enlarge one arch/opening into the dominant spatial event
morphologies.aperture_rule: openings are tall ovals, bubble windows, or deep rounded slots with no rectilinear curtain-wall grid
construction_cues: one shared plinth or docking line
one integrated signal, canopy, or transit edge
morphologies.material_direction: warm pale concrete, mint or cream enamel, translucent glass, subtle polished trim, and soft daylight; avoid sterile white render architecture
